reviewPolicy.standard: Use the supplied commentary as the controlling theological standard while preserving source uncertainty and established alternatives.
reviewPolicy.favoredView: Present a favored interpretation as primary without erasing qualifications or incomplete evidence.
reviewPolicy.unresolvedView: When the standard retains alternatives, represent them proportionately and do not convert uncertainty into certainty.
reviewPolicy.publicCitation: Paraphrase the standard; do not expose source citations, review labels, or internal alignment metadata on public routes.
reviewPolicy.modernEvidence: Compatible modern historical or archaeological proposals may remain when clearly identified as proposals.
